description:
Virtual queue for hot on-sales with fair ordering, purchase limits (per customer account / per event), rate limiting and suspicious-order flagging.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Queue admits fairly (no line-jumping) and meters load into checkout
- Purchase limits enforce at checkout across guest/account identities
- Abuse signals flag orders for staff review without blocking legitimate buyers

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map).

**Amended (grilling):** Design-target on-sale (owner NFR): ~50-100k capacity event, 100k+ concurrent buyers in the waiting room, thousands of checkout attempts/min sustained. Purchase-limit identity: limits key on customer accounts; events with strict limits can require login (guest checkout stays available elsewhere). Card/device fingerprinting NOT in v1.

**Amended (owner directive 2026-07-12):** bot detection/prevention must NOT blanket-block non-human traffic — LLM agents are legitimate buyers (TKT-40). Countermeasures target scalper automation; declared, limit-abiding agents get a defined lane through queue and checkout. Every blocking mechanism in this epic must state how it treats declared agents.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level. Not yet decomposed — US-stories are created when the owner prioritizes this epic (Gate 1), per PRD 'Capability map'.
Backlog grilling 2026-07-12 (owner decisions): festival-scale NFR quantified; limit identity = account-required for strict-limit events.

Final review fix: original description still said limits keyed 'per customer/card/event', contradicting the grilling amendment (account-keyed, no card/device fingerprinting in v1). Original text corrected.

Owner directive pre-commit: SEO/GEO/agent-first is a must (new epic TKT-40). Constraint added here: no blanket bot-blocking — distinguish scalper automation from legitimate agents; the balance policy is co-owned with TKT-40.
